releases.notes:
## Mountain goats

Vanilla goats can now be tamed and ridden as mountain mounts. Their appearance, horns, screaming variants, milk, breeding and wild spawning are preserved.

- Tame an adult goat by riding it with an empty hand, then equip a saddle. Tamed goats have ten hearts and can be healed with wheat.
- Equip existing horse armour with models and textures made for goats in Blockbench, including dyeable leather and separate leather straps.
- Hold and release **Space** to use the native horse jump bar, rear and leap up to approximately **12 blocks**. Goat-specific strength and forward momentum retain Minecraft's terrain and potion modifiers.
- Hold **R** to lower the head, then release to ram. The charge uses vanilla goat damage, knockback, sounds and horn breaking, stops at the first impact and respects PvP and team rules. A short tap cancels preparation.
- Ordinary mountain jumps protect both goat and rider from fall damage. Large drops remain dangerous. Wild and unmounted goats retain their ordinary jump strength.
- Saddles and armour persist, drop on death and can be recovered with shears while dismounted. Friends can ride an equipped goat.

Built for **Minecraft 26.1.2**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer**, and **Fabric API**. Install the same mod version on the client and server.

Validation: 78 server GameTests and a real client/server play test covering the 12-block jump, safe landing, native jump rearing, movement, sprinting, short-R cancellation and mounted ramming.

releases.notes:
## Wither Compass teleportation

Build matching 7 by 7 platforms from 49 blocks of a single beacon material, with a Lodestone on top of the centre block. Bind a compass to the destination, then charge it with one Nether Star at an anvil for one experience level.

- Start a journey by using the Wither Compass on the departure Lodestone. Other players join with an empty main hand. One charge covers the entire group.
- Iron carries players within 4,000 horizontal blocks. Gold adds animals and monsters and shortens preparation. Emerald also carries villagers and wandering traders. Diamond removes the distance limit within a dimension. Netherite connects dimensions. Additional Additions' rose gold also keeps players on their living mounts.
- Travellers keep their exact horizontal position and looking direction. Arrival height follows the destination covering, so bare, slab and carpeted platforms can connect.
- Platforms can be concealed beneath a decorative floor. Particles show the boarding area and selected travellers above the covering, with familiar Minecraft sounds throughout the journey.
- Blocked or interrupted journeys preserve the charge. Successful travel returns an ordinary compass that keeps its destination and name. Players receive three seconds of Blindness.
- Villagers preserve trades and inventory. Living mounts preserve their rider, saddle and equipment. Cross-dimensional creatures retain their identity and data.

The previous covered-campfire flight stations and subtle smoke remain included.

Built for Minecraft 26.1.2 and Fabric. Update both client and server. Additional Additions is optional and enables rose-gold platforms.

[Teleportation guide](https://fixedbydesign.com/wiki/teleportation)

releases.notes:
## Covered campfire flight stations

- Place a closed trapdoor directly above a lit campfire to keep only a few small smoke wisps visible above the lid.
- Crouch on the trapdoor with Elytra equipped to charge, then stand up to launch. Neighbouring campfire and hay bonuses, plus Smokestack charges, are preserved.
- Open the trapdoor to restore the tall smoke column and allow gliders to ride the updraft overhead.
- Both upper and lower trapdoors work, including iron trapdoors controlled by redstone. Each campfire needs its own lid.
- Extinguished campfires cannot recharge a glider. Solid roofs and water still block updrafts.

Built for Minecraft 26.1.2 with Fabric. Install the updated mod on both client and server.

Beta release for Minecraft 1.21.11.

Fixes a startup crash caused by the end city loot mixin, which made v0.1.2-beta+1.21.11 unable to boot. Also backports the horse locator bar fixes from 26.1.2: the missing horse icon now renders, hidden while the horse is leashed or ridden, and only shown to its owner.
